svg.aria-label: A mature European age structure, by sex
svg.desc: Population pyramid: Men (left) and Women (right) across 18 ordered bands, youngest at the bottom. 17 closed bands 5-wide plus the open-ended '85+', whose row is not width-comparable. Men totals 41,565 thousands, Women totals 41,855 thousands, grand total 83,420 thousands. Bars are counts in thousands. 85+: Men 690, Women 1,520; 80–84: Men 1,180, Women 1,520; 75–79: Men 1,720, Women 1,950; 70–74: Men 2,250, Women 2,400; 65–69: Men 2,450, Women 2,530; 60–64: Men 2,540, Women 2,560; 55–59: Men 2,905, Women 2,895; 50–54: Men 3,290, Women 3,225; 45–49: Men 3,350, Women 3,255; 40–44: Men 2,915, Women 2,810; 35–39: Men 2,665, Women 2,545; 30–34: Men 2,610, Women 2,455; 25–29: Men 2,570, Women 2,380; 20–24: Men 2,450, Women 2,255; 15–19: Men 2,115, Women 1,990; 10–14: Men 2,010, Women 1,905; 5–9: Men 1,980, Women 1,880; 0–4: Men 1,875, Women 1,780.
